Lena (VP People): Quick post-all-hands thread 1 small clarifications.

Maya (IC): Quick one 1 when exactly is the promo packet cutoff?

Ava (People Ops): Packet deadline: 2026-04-25 EOD PT. Calibration week starts 2026-05-05.

Kai (Eng): If someone is on short-term medical leave and misses the cutoff, is there a path?

Ava (People Ops): Yes 1 managers file an exception request via the people-ops portal with a short note. We aim to respond within 7 business days.

Maya (IC): Will there be a packet prep office hour?

Lena (VP People): Yes 1 optional 30-min office hour next Wed 9am PT, recording + notes will be posted.

Maya (IC): Do promotions go into Workday automatically after approval?

Ava (People Ops): We ingest approvals and update Workday; expect a 1-3 business day lag. Managers get a confirmation email.

allhands-bot: Doc uploaded: packet-checklist-2026.pdf (uploaded by Ava).

Lena (VP People): Thanks all 1 leave any other short Qs here and we'll add links.
